Maya (Procurement): Hey team — RateBridge sent pilot terms. Need quick sanity check before I reply.
Owen (Finance): What are the headline unit rates, invoice terms, and how does their $5k pilot credit apply? Can you paste the summary?
Maya (Procurement): Pasted below: embeddings billed per 1k vectors, generation per 1k tokens, $5k credit, 3-month optional commit, monthly invoices net-30, 30d default retention. Also they mention overage = 120% of committed rate.
Priya (Eng): embeddings per-1k vectors is standard. For our planning we need a conversion from our request profile -> billed units. Small sample from staging: requests=12k, avg_tokens=220, avg_vectors=6.
Carlos - RateBridge: Hi all, Carlos here. Pilot unit rates: embeddings $0.90 /1k vectors, generation $0.015 /1k tokens. $5k credit applies to invoices during pilot (covers commit or overage). We invoice monthly net-30; can offer net-45 with PO. Retention can be toggled to 365 for pilots.
Owen (Finance): Thanks. For Priya's sample that maps to 72 embedding units and 2640 gen units. I'll plug into the model. Two asks: can they prorate mid-term commitment increases and what's the early-termination treatment?
Carlos - RateBridge: We prorate increases. Early termination: 30d notice; if you take a committed discount then terminate early we invoice the effective discount recoup proportional to usage.
Alex (Legal): Need DPA and CPRA language for pilot; any SOC2/ISO posture?
Carlos - RateBridge: We have a DPA and will accept reasonable CPRA redlines. SOC2 Type II in progress, ISO27001 targeted Q4. Will share reports as available.
Priya (Eng): Quick technical Q: do cache hits get billed as generation?
Carlos - RateBridge: Prefetch/cache hits are not billed for generation tokens. We may apply a small request handling fee at extreme TPS but generally no charge for cache hits.
Sam (PM): Next: Maya to request a short addendum with explicit unit rates, credit application rules, net-45 PO option, 365-day retention toggle, and DPA. Also schedule a 30-min demo focusing on billing export, rate limits, and SSO.
Maya (Procurement): I'll draft the addendum and ask for the demo calendar. Carlos, please DM availability mornings PST.
Owen (Finance): I'll run a 6-month spend projection with the pilot rates and share the CSV.
Alex (Legal): I'll queue DPA review once received.
Carlos - RateBridge: DM sent with calendar. Thanks everyone.
Maya (Procurement): Great, will update thread with vendor response and addendum draft when ready.
